RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the August 6, 2002/Sravana 15, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Civil  Aviation; Commerce and Industry; Finance and
Company Affairs; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism and
Culture; Water Resources)
Total number of questions—155
WIN2\SESSION\2537RS 458
Delay in development of airports in NE
Region
2071. SHRI RISHANG KEISHING:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether development of airports in
the North East Region has been seriously
hampered due to delay in execution and cost
escalation;
(b) if so, the reasons for delay in
construction and completion; and
(c) what  remedial measures
Government have taken in this regard?
Revival of Delhi flying club
2072. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
DR. ABRAR AHMED:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
revive and introduce new features for the
Delhi flying club; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Upgradation of Lucknow airport
2073. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken
action for upgradation of Lucknow airport;
(b) if so, whether any action plan has
been formulated by Government in this
regard; and
(c) the steps being taken or proposed to
be taken by Government in this regard?
Serving of eatables to air passengers
†2074. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that responsibility
to sell eatables at Airports and serving of
eatables to air passengers has been entrusted
to private sector;
(b) if so, what are the details of the
private sector firms together with the
responsibilities as well as the places for
which the work has been entrusted;

(c) whether rate of dividend is also fixed
for private sector while entering into an
agreement for imparting responsibility; and
(d) if so, the details of the rate and system
adopted to monitor the said rate?
Leasing of aerodromes
†2075. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
of Malaysia have requested the Indian
counterpart to lease out the Chennai
aerodrome;
(b) if so, what is Government's reaction
thereto;
(c) whether Government are going to
take some strategic decision to lease out
Indian aerodromes; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
AI flights to European countries
2076. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Air India had stopped its
flights to some European countries and other
destinations in Australia and Korea;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) what steps are being taken to resume
the flights?
Flights from Bangalore to major cities
of Karnataka
2077. SHRI M.V. RAJASEKHARAN:
SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any requests to operate Indian Airlines/
Private Airlines to link major cities of
Karnataka with Bangalore;
(b) if so, whether Government have
conducted any study of the Air traffic
potential in the region; and
(c) if so, whether the Ministry of Civil
Aviation has agreed to start Air operations
of Indian Airlines from Bangalore to the
other major cities of Karnataka?
Rebate to Government employees
2078. SHRI RAJNATH SINGH
'SURYA': Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the AI is giving some rebate/
facilities to Government servants travelling
officially by this carrier;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government servants on
personal journeys will also get some
concessions, etc.; and
(d) if not, whether Government would
consider such a proposal for promoting
tourism and attracting more passengers?
Sale of air tickets by authorised
companies

'LALAN':
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several firms
have been authorised for sale of air tickets
by the Department of Civil Aviation;
(b) if so, the total number of firms so
authorised till June, 2002;
